name: xv6 OSTEP Projects
postCreateCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential gdb qemu-system-riscv git wget xz-utils libpixman-1-dev && wget -q https://download.qemu.org/qemu-8.2.0.tar.xz && tar xf qemu-8.2.0.tar.xz && cd qemu-8.2.0 && ./configure --target-list=riscv64-softmmu && make -j$(nproc) && sudo make install && cd .. && rm -rf qemu-8.2.0* && wget -q https://static.dev.sifive.com/dev-tools/freedom-tools/v2020.12/riscv64-unknown-elf-toolchain-10.2.0-x86_64-linux-ubuntu14.tar.gz && tar xf riscv64-unknown-elf-toolchain-10.2.0-x86_64-linux-ubuntu14.tar.gz && sudo mv riscv64-unknown-elf-toolchain-10.2.0-x86_64-linux-ubuntu14 /opt/riscv && echo 'export PATH=/opt/riscv/bin:$PATH' >> ~/.bashrc
